# DataGridColumnPicker

`Flare.Components.DataGridColumnPicker`

A button with a menu of the grid's columns, where each column is shown or hidden with a check.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Columns` | `IReadOnlyList<ValueTuple<string, string>>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Optional explicit pickable columns as (Key, Title) pairs. When null, the bound grid's non-composite columns are used. |
| `Hidden` | `IReadOnlyCollection<string>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Optional explicit set of hidden column keys. When null, the bound grid's HiddenColumnKeys are used. |
| `Label` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Label shown on the picker button. Defaults to a localized "Columns". |
| `OnToggle` | `EventCallback<string>` | `` | Callback |  | Optional notification raised with a column key when its visibility is toggled. The bound grid is updated automatically; use this only to observe the change. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional attributes. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Class` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional CSS class(es) appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Context` | `DataGridContext<TItem>?` | `` | Parameter |  | The grid context this control drives. Set it to place the control anywhere on the page; omit it inside a grid, where the cascade supplies one. Inherited from `FlareDataGridControl`. |
| `Grid` | `FlareDataGrid<TItem>?` | `` | Parameter |  | The grid this control drives, as an alternative to Context when the page already holds an @ref to the grid itself. Inherited from `FlareDataGridControl`. |
| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style string appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
